clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, young Horde recruits test their strength in southern Durotar. Orcs and Darkspear trolls face the valley’s wildlife and dangers before they leave ready to defend their people.

Young fighters face the Valley of Trials before they venture into Durotar. Chieftains and trainers watch over them from The Den, a shelter carved into the cliffs. In the sunlit gulch, recruits hunt scorpids, cull aggressive boars, and keep lazy peons in line as they harvest scarce timber. The trial is hard, and only those who prove their mettle earn the right to leave as soldiers of the Horde. Those who fail are left beneath the desert sun.
